phases = the Gen-e2 PDLC stage(s) the package is registered for. Empty array = 'Phase not set' on the marketplace.
component descriptions are truncated to ~220 chars as shown on the marketplace card.
install_command uses the apm marketplace proxy; note three different source repos: gen-e2-marketplace, gen-e2-rules, gen-e2-plugins.
duplicate names exist across repos (agentic-workflows x2, initialize-context x2) - disambiguate by id / install_command.
